description: This source file implements the UE event management system for a 5G NR scheduler, including handling of buffer occupancy updates, UE creation/reconfiguration/deletion, UCI/CSI/SRS indications, error handling, and event queuing within a cellular context.

classes.name: ue_cell_event_manager::ue_dl_buffer_occupancy_manager
classes.description: Manages DL buffer occupancy updates per UE and bearer, ensuring updates are processed efficiently and only once per slot.

methods.name: handle_dl_buffer_state_indication
methods.description: Handles incoming DL buffer occupancy indications, updating internal state and enqueuing events.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Processes all pending DL buffer updates at the start of a slot.

methods.name: handle_ue_creation
methods.description: Handles creation of a new UE, updating relevant schedulers and logging.

methods.name: handle_ue_reconfiguration
methods.description: Handles reconfiguration of an existing UE.

methods.name: handle_ue_deletion
methods.description: Handles deletion of a UE, removing it from schedulers and repositories.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Confirms UE configuration application and updates slice scheduler.

methods.name: handle_ue_deactivation_request
methods.description: Handles deactivation requests for UEs.

methods.name: handle_ul_bsr_indication
methods.description: Processes Uplink Buffer Status Reports.

methods.name: handle_crc_indication
methods.description: Processes CRC indications, updating HARQ and logging.

methods.name: handle_uci_pdu
methods.description: Processes UCI PDUs, handling HARQ ACKs, SRs, CSI, and SINR updates.

methods.name: handle_uci_indication
methods.description: Processes multiple UCI indications for a cell.

methods.name: handle_srs_indication
methods.description: Processes SRS indications, updating channel matrices and timing.

methods.name: handle_ul_phr_indication
methods.description: Processes PHR indications for uplink power control.

methods.name: handle_dl_mac_ce_indication
methods.description: Handles DL MAC control element indications.

methods.name: handle_positioning_measurement_request
methods.description: Handles positioning measurement requests.

methods.name: handle_positioning_measurement_stop
methods.description: Handles stopping of positioning measurements.

methods.name: handle_dl_buffer_state_indication
methods.description: Delegates DL buffer state indications to the buffer occupancy manager.

methods.name: handle_error_indication
methods.description: Handles error indications, including discarded grants and metrics reporting.

methods.name: handle_slice_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Handles slice reconfiguration requests.

methods.name: handle_harq_ind
methods.description: Processes HARQ ACK/NACK information and updates HARQ state.

methods.name: handle_csi
methods.description: Processes CSI reports.

methods.name: handle_uci_indication_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout for UCI indications, updating HARQ and SR states.

methods.name: push_event
methods.description: Enqueues an event for processing if the cell is active.

methods.name: log_invalid_ue_index
methods.description: Logs warning or info about invalid UE indices.

methods.name: log_invalid_cc
methods.description: Logs warning or info about invalid UE component carriers.
